# __DISPLAY_NAME__

> Platform micro-frontend (`__MFE_ID__`): TanStack Router routes under `__ROUTE_PREFIX__`, widgets, commands, settings and storage through `@platform/react`.

## Project
- [README](README.md): commands and layout
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical patterns and rules for contributors and agents
- [llm.txt](llm.txt): one-page API and file reference
- [mfe.config.ts](mfe.config.ts): manifest-affecting configuration
- [src/mfe.tsx](src/mfe.tsx): bootstrap
